_comment: English body for fireflies-ai; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by third-party speech-recognition and generative summarisation models; the model list is not disclosed item by item, and features vary by tier.
axes.runtime: A cloud meeting bot joins Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and similar meetings; recording, transcription and summaries are processed server-side.
axes.local_files: Can upload audio or connect to a meeting; local recordings must be uploaded and cannot be read directly from a local meeting cache. Local files usually need upload or authorised access, so confirm storage, retention and deletion.
axes.background: The bot runs during the meeting and produces a summary afterwards; it is not a general post-shutdown agent. Tasks are triggered per request and no resident agent remains.
axes.tools: Integrations with Zoom, Meet, Teams, CRM, Slack and Notion can write action items back to external systems.
axes.context: Context is mainly one meeting, past meetings and team knowledge; cross-organisation retrieval is limited by permissions. Cross-document and cross-session memory is limited, so complex work needs manual context and source citations.
axes.permissions: Recording and transcription require participant consent; retention, region and admin controls follow the enterprise contract.
axes.fit: Fits: automatic notes and action items for sales, recruiting and project meetings. Does not fit: secret meetings, regulated conversations or fully offline processing.
